test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 12 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Six friends E, F, G, H, l and J are seated around a round table facing the centre. E is seated 2ⁿd to the tight of I. Only G is seated between H and J. Where is F seated?
solution:
Given → Six friends E, F, G, H, l and J are seated around a round table facing the centre.

1) E is seated 2ⁿd to the right of I.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e752a6af6db677c0409b8a13e30b98ca7a0e4b5b9d18915886de0a84cd3921a5.png] 

2) Only G is seated between H and J.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5f144e81a1e53196a5925d7d6ee1e5bdb91970a0c557feac2e973e644d562c48.png] 

3) F will be seated at the empty place around a round table.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a5fed82d97767b5a02bfcf8a4c4f3ab63fcd324cf67fd854e7992990aa9ebe1.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"3rd to the left of G".**
